cases.prompt: Write a Nemo.js test that logs into our site.
expectations: Configures Nemo with the nemo-view plugin and a local browser.
Defines locators in a JSON locator file.
Uses Mocha before and after hooks that create Nemo and quit the driver.

cases.prompt: How should I organize locators in a Nemo.js project?
expectations: Puts locators in JSON files per page under a locator directory.
Accesses them through nemo.view generated methods.
Prefers stable selectors such as ids or data attributes.
